summary_md: **Worth Cloning ([@worthcloning](https://x.com/worthcloning/status/2116784840800604269))** reviews **Tracely**, a self-hostable tool whose README says it grades agent traces, clusters failures and freezes a failing run into a hermetic CI test replayed offline without API keys, with a gate to block PRs; caveats include SDK dependence, a four-service Docker setup and no default login ([jwuthri-cloud/Tracely-ai](https://github.com/jwuthri-cloud/Tracely-ai)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - jwuthri-cloud/Tracely-ai: Trace-native CI/CD for AI agents: grade production traces, cluster failures, freeze them into replayable regression tests, and block PRs that regress. Self-hostable.

relevance: Regression testing agent failures in CI.
